scope: Original layout studies only; no research findings or commercial template materials.
renderBasis: LibreOffice PPTX to PDF; inspected rendered contact sheets covering every page.
checks: All text and shapes retained as native PowerPoint objects; no page screenshots.
All 32 pages inspected for title/body hierarchy, clipping, overlap and connection routing.
Synthetic or conceptual identity visible on every page.
No purchased-template images, logos, fonts or example research findings copied.
limitation: The review environment substituted Droid Sans Fallback for unavailable Microsoft YaHei. This checks structure and readable CJK rendering, not pixel-identical fidelity to every PowerPoint environment. Human acceptance and research-content validation are separate.
